evals.prompt: A fresh session starts inside a known project whose entry links many large companions. Describe the ordered brain reads.
evals.expected_output: Loads brain config, index, primary context, and only the active entry point; remains silent and read-only.

evals.prompt: The cwd is /Users/me/src and the user asks to change the service without naming one.
evals.expected_output: Does not invent a src node and asks for project identity after global orientation.

evals.prompt: A task switches from one project to a named Mesh wiki area.
evals.expected_output: Loads the wiki entry point and only the relevant area note if needed.
